# Raw data 
```{r}
# Define pathogen
selpat_l <- c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "polio", "hib",
              "ipv", "opv", "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv",
              "multi_ipv", "multi_pertu", "multi_men", "multi_polio", "multi_opv",
              "multi_dtp", "multi_dtpa", "multi_dtpw", "multi_hib-men", "multi_mmr", "multi_mmr-vzv")

# Define vaccination
vac_l <-  case_when(
  selpat_l %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "multi_mmr", "hav", "multi_mmr-vzv") ~ "v1",
  .default = "vl")
names(vac_l) <- selpat_l

# Read in the data 
dat_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/data_brms_{x}_{vac_l[[x]]}_s08.rds"))}, simplify = FALSE)
# Read in the convergence
df_rhats_cs <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres_rhats/df_rhats_cs.rds"))
# Read in the waic

  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  filter(waic == min(waic))
```

# Function to check gaps 
```{r}
fun_checkgaps <- function(x) {
  # Sort the vector
  sorted_x <- sort(x)
  # Compute the differences between consecutive elements
  gaps <- diff(sorted_x)
  # Check the gap between the last element and the first element, considering the circularity (52 back to 1)
  circular_gap <- (52 - max(sorted_x)) + (min(sorted_x) - 1)
  # Check if any gap is larger than 25, including the circular gap
  any(gaps > 25) || circular_gap > 25
}
```

# Function to read conditional effects 
```{r}
fun_condeffects <- function(mod = mod, clu_name = NA, multi = FALSE, pat = "rota") {
  
  # Take out gauss if necessary
  clu_name <- str_remove(clu_name, "_gauss")
  
  # Prepare data 
  dat <- mutate(dat_l[[pat]], pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    distinct(vac_week_v1, pi_vac_week_v1)
  pref_clu_name <- if(!is.na(clu_name)) paste0(":", clu_name) else ""
  # Create group vector 
  var_vector <- c()
  
  # Extract conditional effects 
  if(multi) {
    ce_effects <- lapply(
      conditional_effects(mod, resolution = 52, effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1{pref_clu_name}")),
      as.data.frame) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "imm_name") %>%
      mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=\\.immvals1anti).+?(?=_pi)"))
    # Attach imm_name to group vector 
    var_vector <- c(var_vector, "imm_name")
  } else {
    ce_effects <- conditional_effects(mod, resolution = 52, effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1{pref_clu_name}"))[[1]]
  }
  
  # Prepare clusters if necessary
  if(!is.na(clu_name)) {
    # Create cluster variable 
    ce_effects <- ce_effects %>%
      rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
      mutate(clu = as.character(clu))
    # Create df of total values per week
    dat_tot <- dat_l[[pat]] %>%
      rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
      mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%
      mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(pi_vac_week_v1, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
      summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(clu) %>%
      mutate(clu_checkgaps = fun_checkgaps(vac_week_v1)) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    # Attach cluster to group vector 
    var_vector <- c(var_vector, "clu")
  } else {
    # Create df of total values per week
    dat_tot <- dat_l[[pat]] %>%
      mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(pi_vac_week_v1, vac_week_v1) %>%
      summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop")
  }
  
  # Obtain estimates 
  ce_effects <- ce_effects %>%
    mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    select(pi_vac_week_v1, estimate__, lower__, upper__, all_of(var_vector)) %>%
    left_join(dat, by = join_by(pi_vac_week_v1)) %>%
    left_join(dat_tot) %>%
    mutate(estimate_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = estimate__),
           lower_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = lower__),
           upper_tot = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = upper__))
  
  return(ce_effects)
}
```

# Read models and extract conditional effects ======================================================
```{r}
# Select only models cs or csi that converged 
# df_converged <- filter(df_rhats_cs, Rhat == FALSE, str_detect(mod, "_cs\\.|_csi_")) %>%
#   mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod, "reg") ~ sub(".*(reg.*)\\.rds.*", "\\1", mod))) %>%
#   filter(pathogen != "multi_pertu")

# Select only models base, cs or csi that converged 
df_converged <- filter(df_rhats_cs, Rhat == FALSE, str_detect(mod, "_cs\\.|_csi_|base")) %>%
  mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod, "reg") ~ sub(".*(reg.*)\\.rds.*", "\\1", mod),
                         str_detect(mod, "base") ~ sub(".*(base.*)\\.rds.*", "\\1", mod))) %>%
  filter(pathogen != "multi_pertu")

# Which are cosines
csmod <- which(!(df_converged$reg %in% c("base","base_gauss")) | (is.na(df_converged$reg)))

# Obtain the conditional effects for each photo period 
ce_dat_l <- sapply(csmod, function(x) {
  pat <- df_converged[x, 'pathogen']
  name_reg <- if(is.na(df_converged[x, "reg"])) "cs" else paste0("csi_", df_converged[x, "reg"])
  # Obtain conditional effects   
  pomp::bake(file = glue(
    "{dirs$outputs}/modres_condeffects/ce_dat_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"), {
    # Read model
    mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{pat}/bm{vac_l[[pat]]}_s08_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"))
    # Obtain conditional effects
    ce_dat <- fun_condeffects(mod = mod, clu_name = df_converged[x, "reg"], 
                              multi = str_detect(pat, "multi"), pat = pat)
    return(ce_dat)
  })
}, simplify = FALSE)
names(ce_dat_l) <- df_converged$mod[csmod]
```

# Read models and extracting coefficients ==========================================================
```{r}
# Obtain the coefficients for each model
coef_l <- sapply(1:length(df_converged[[1]]), function(x) {
  pat <- df_converged[x, 'pathogen']
  #name_reg <- if(is.na(df_converged[x, "reg"])) "cs" else paste0("csi_", df_converged[x, "reg"])
  name_reg <- case_when(
    is.na(df_converged[x, "reg"]) ~ "cs",
    str_detect(df_converged[x, "reg"], "reg") ~ paste0("csi_", df_converged[x, "reg"]),
    str_detect(df_converged[x, "reg"], "base") ~ df_converged[x, "reg"])
  # Obtain conditional effects   
  pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres_coef/coef_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"), {
    # Read model
    mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{pat}/bm{vac_l[[pat]]}_s08_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"))
    # Obtain conditional effects
    sum_coef <- summary(mod)
    return(sum_coef)
  })
}, simplify = FALSE)
names(coef_l) <- df_converged$mod
```

# Extract coefficients for the cosinor =============================================================  
```{r}
# Extract coefficients for the cosinor and obtain amplitude and phase
coef_cosine_l <- lapply(coef_l, function(x) rownames_to_column(x$fixed, var = "parameter")) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  # Coefficients of the cosinor only 
  filter(str_detect(parameter, "cos|sin")) %>%
  mutate(param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos",
                           str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin")) %>%
  # Attach pathogen and reg 
  left_join(select(df_converged, -Rhat), by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  # Extract the imm_name and clu from the parameter name
  mutate(
    imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
    clu = str_remove_all(parameter, "reg|_2|_3|_4|_6|cospi_vac_week_v1|sinpi_vac_week_v1|:|immvals1anti|_gauss"),
    clu = case_when(!is.na(imm_name) ~ str_remove_all(clu, imm_name), .default = clu),
    clu = sub("^_", "", clu),
    clu = case_when(
      str_detect(reg, "reg_2") & clu == "" ~ "1_North",
      str_detect(reg, "reg_3|reg_4|reg_6") & clu == "" ~ "1_Temperate",
      !is.na(reg) & clu != "" ~ clu)) %>%
  select(pathogen, mod, param, reg, clu, imm_name, Estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  # Estimate amplitude and phase
  mutate(
    amp = sqrt((p_cos^2) + (p_sin^2)),
    # Periodic phi in radians
    periodic_phi = case_when(
      p_cos > 0 ~ atan((-1*p_sin)/(p_cos)),
      p_cos < 0 ~ atan((-1*p_sin)/(p_cos)) - pi),
    # Periodic phi in weeks
    periodic_phi_week = 52*(periodic_phi*-1)/(2*pi)) %>%
  # Estimate phi empirically 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(phi_emp = which(p_cos*cos(2*pi*(1:52)/52) + p_sin*sin(2*pi*(1:52)/52) == 
                           max(p_cos*cos(2*pi*(1:52)/52) + p_sin*sin(2*pi*(1:52)/52)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Estimate phi 
  mutate(
    phi = case_when(
      periodic_phi_week < 0 ~ periodic_phi_week + 52,
      periodic_phi_week > 0 ~ periodic_phi_week,
      periodic_phi_week == 0 ~ 0),
    phi = case_when(phi > 0 & phi < 1 ~ 52, .default = phi)) %>%
  # Create column for waic over baseline model or not
  mutate(minwaic = !(pathogen %in% df_minwaic[str_detect(df_minwaic$mod, "base"),]$pathogen))

saveRDS(coef_cosine_l, glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres_coef_cosine.rds"))
```

# Extract spaghetti conditional effects ============================================================
```{r}
# Select only models cs or csi that converged 
df_converged_sel <- filter(df_rhats_cs, Rhat == FALSE, str_detect(mod, "_cs\\.|_csi_")) %>%
  mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod, "reg") ~ sub(".*(reg.*)\\.rds.*", "\\1", mod))) %>%
  filter(pathogen != "multi_pertu") %>%
  filter(str_detect(mod, clu_name))

# Obtain the conditional effects with spaguetti 
spa_dat_l <- sapply(1:length(df_converged_sel[[1]]), function(x) {
  pat <- df_converged_sel[x, 'pathogen']
  name_reg <- if(is.na(df_converged_sel[x, "reg"])) "cs" else paste0("csi_", df_converged_sel[x, "reg"])
  pomp::bake(file = glue(
    "{dirs$outputs}/modres_condeffects/ce_dat_spa_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"), {
    # Read model
    pref_clu_name <- if(!is.na(clu_name)) paste0(":", clu_name) else ""
    mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{pat}/bm{vac_l[[pat]]}_s08_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"))
    # Obtain spaghetti conditional effects
    ce_dat_spa <- conditional_effects(mod, resolution = 52, effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1{pref_clu_name}"), 
                                      spaghetti = TRUE, ndraws = 100, re_formula = NULL)
    spa_dat <- sapply(ce_dat_spa, function(subx) {
        attr(subx, "spaghetti") %>%
          group_by(all_of(clu_name), sample__) %>%
          mutate(estimate_norm = (estimate__/mean(estimate__, na.rm = TRUE)))
      }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "imm_name")
    
    return(spa_dat)
  }) 
}, simplify = FALSE)
names(spa_dat_l) <- df_converged_sel$mod
```

## Data for the plot 
```{r}
dat_pl1 <- bind_rows(spa_dat_l, .id = "mod") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(clu = all_of(clu_name)) %>%
  mutate(clu = str_remove_all(clu, " ")) %>%
  left_join(df_converged_sel, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=immvals1anti).+?(?=\\.)"),
         pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
  select(pathogen, imm_name, pi_vac_week_v1, clu, estimate__, sample__, estimate_norm) %>%
  left_join(rename(dat_plot, estimate_mean = estimate__), by = join_by(pathogen, imm_name, pi_vac_week_v1, clu)) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, imm_name, clu) %>%
  mutate(estimate_mean_norm = estimate_mean/mean(estimate_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #filter(minwaic) %>%
  filter(pathogen %in% c("multi_dtpa", "hav", "hbv", "hib", "ipv", "multi_mmr", "men",
                         "rota", "vzv")) %>%
  mutate(imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, ""), 
         sam_imm = paste0(sample__, "_", pathogen, imm_name), 
         pat_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_mmr", "multi_dtpa") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = pathogen),
         pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy,  levels = names(pat_tidy_names), labels = pat_tidy_names),
         imm_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_men", "multi_ipv") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = NA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mod))
```

# Read models and extracting coefficients for base models
```{r}
df_fixed <- sapply(coef_l, function(x) {
  x$fixed %>%
    rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
    filter(str_detect(parameter, "age|sex|vac_conc|time_v1_v2|time_v2_v3|time_vl_s1"))}, 
  simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  # Attach pathogen and reg 
  left_join(select(df_converged, -Rhat), by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  # Extract the imm_name and clu from the parameter name
  mutate(imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
         parameter = case_when(!is.na(imm_name) ~ str_remove_all(parameter, imm_name),
                               .default = parameter),
         parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "immvals1anti_")) 
  
df_fixed %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = imm_name, color = reg)) + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_point() + 
    geom_segment(aes(x = `l-95% CI`, xend = `u-95% CI`, yend = imm_name)) + 
  facet_grid(pathogen+imm_name~parameter, scales = "free", switch = "y") + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0))
```

```{r}
for (i in unique(df_fixed$parameter)) {
pl <- df_fixed %>%
  filter(parameter == i)  %>%
  filter(reg == "base") %>%
  mutate(effect_cuali = case_when(`l-95% CI` < 0 & `u-95% CI` < 0 ~ "negative",

                                  .default = "nonsig")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = reorder(pathogen, Estimate), color = effect_cuali)) + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_segment(aes(x = `l-95% CI`, xend = `u-95% CI`, yend = pathogen), alpha = 0.8) + 
    geom_point(size = 4, color = "white") + 
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "grey", "#0D0887FF")) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Estimated effect") + 
  theme(#axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
        legend.position = "none") + 
  ggtitle(i)
print(pl)
}
```

# Checking the correlation matrices ================================================================
```{r}
library(corrplot)
library("ggcorrplot")

df_converged_multi <- df_converged %>%
  filter(str_detect(reg, "base") & str_detect(pathogen, "multi")) %>%
  filter(!(pathogen %in% c("multi_dtp", "multi_polio")))

# Obtain the correlation matrix from the base models
corrmatrix_l <- sapply(1:length(df_converged_multi[[1]]), function(x) {
  pat <- df_converged_multi[x, 'pathogen']
  name_reg <- df_converged_multi[x, "reg"]
  # Obtain conditional effects   
  pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres_coef/corrmatrix_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"), {
    # Read model
    mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{pat}/bm{vac_l[[pat]]}_s08_{pat}_{name_reg}.rds"))
    # Obtain correlation matrix
    corrmatrix <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mod)$residual__$cor) %>%
      select(starts_with("Estimate"))
    return(corrmatrix)
  })
}, simplify = FALSE)
names(corrmatrix_l) <- df_converged_multi$pathogen

corrmatrix_pl <- lapply(1:length(corrmatrix_l), function(x) {
  names(corrmatrix_l[[x]]) <- str_remove(names(corrmatrix_l[[x]]), "Estimate.immvals1anti")
  rownames(corrmatrix_l[[x]]) <- str_remove(rownames(corrmatrix_l[[x]]), "immvals1anti")
  ggcorrplot(corrmatrix_l[[x]], hc.order = TRUE, lab = TRUE) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
      ggtitle(names(corrmatrix_l)[[x]])})
wrap_plots(corrmatrix_pl)
```
